background_load_15min.csv.derivation: Use the official 2021 ComStock/ResStock TMY3 New York state building-class aggregates as heterogeneous shapes. Match each BEM bus to its corresponding class, including ResStock Multi-Family with 5+ Units for BEM08; cycle the frozen class set over other buses; normalize each bus to 60% of the original case33bw node P peak and preserve its original Q/P ratio.

bem_baseline_15min.csv.derivation: Run each transitioned Buffalo IDF; set aggregation_factor so portfolio baseline peak equals 40% of the original case33bw node peak. Never scale temperature.

pv_15min.csv.derivation: Pinned local pvlib ModelChain driven by the shared EPW and der/pv.json; generation is positive and subtracted from consumption at the coupling boundary.

prices_15min.csv.derivation: Freeze the official ISO-NE 2025 SMD Hourly Data workbook for the NEMA/Boston load zone and repeat each final hourly RT LMP over its four contained 15-minute intervals. No unobserved within-hour variation is invented.
quality_gates: hour-ending conversion and DST rule documented

reserve_15min.csv.derivation: Select official ISO-NE reserve zone 7002 (NEMA/Boston); arithmetically average every three consecutive 5-minute TMSR, TMNSR, and TMOR price/designation values to 15 minutes. Preserve designation terminology rather than relabelling it as a requirement.

daily_metrics.csv.derivation: Deterministic daily aggregation of frozen full-year inputs and baseline pandapower outputs; used only by select_target_days.py.

models/rc_parameters.json.derivation: Fit seasonal scalar ARX forms of the RC state equation by standardized ridge least squares on development dates; evaluate only on reference dates and exclude target/test-candidate dates.

forbidden_shortcuts: Do not replace missing OEDI or market inputs with an unlabeled sinusoid.
Do not copy target/test intervals into development-derived limits.
Do not imply that TMY weather and historical market prices are causally paired.
